name: Can you match a color from an object other than paint, like fabric or tile?

mainEntity.name: Can you match a color from an object other than paint, like fabric or tile?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we can often match paint colors from non-paint objects like fabric, wallpaper, or tile. Our color matching technology can analyze the chromatic data from various materials to create a custom paint formula. While the texture and reflectivity of the original object will differ from paint, we strive to capture the closest possible hue. Providing a clean, representative sample of the object helps achieve the most accurate result for your desired paint color.
